purpose: issue #18, ACI part: why details.tcb_status was null. Phala's verify endpoint returns no computed TCB status or advisory IDs: the quote object's keys are exactly these four. It does return raw signed Intel collateral under quote_collateral (including tcb_info with TCB levels for fmspc 20A06F000000), from which a status could be computed, but computes no verdict itself. The adapter therefore verifies the quote locally with dcap-qvl against the same Intel collateral source and retains status + advisory IDs verbatim.
